results.description: #କ ୍ଷତିଗ୍ରସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ_ମିଳିବ_କ୍ଷତିପୂରଣ #ର ାଜସ୍ବ_ମନ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ_ବଡ଼_ସୂଚନା ରାଜ୍ୟର ବନ୍ୟା କ୍ଷୟକ୍ଷତି ଜନିତ କ୍ଷତିପୂରଣକୁ ନେଇ ବଡ଼ ସୂଚନା ଦେଇଛନ୍ତି ରାଜସ୍ବ ମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ ସୁରେଶ ପୂଜାରୀ। ଅନେକ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଘର ଭାଙ୍ଗିବାର ରିପୋର୍ଟ ହସ୍ତଗତ ହୋଇଛି। କ୍ଷୟକ୍ଷତି ଆକଳନ କରାଯାଇ ରିପୋର୍ଟ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଯିବ। Odisha Revenue Minister Suresh Pujari has announced that flood-affected people will receive compensation after a detailed assessment of the damage caused by the recent floods across the state. results.title: WSHA focus on employability in Indian hospitality sector: CEO Mandziuk
results.description: The World Sustainable Hospitality Alliance is training two thousand young Indians for hospitality careers. This program actively operates in twenty cities, empowering vulnerable youth with essential skills. Graduates gain practical experience and secure full-time employment after completing their training. The initiative aims to foster inclusivity and build a resilient workforce for the industry.

results.title: Teenage Badminton Star Tanvi Sharma Wins First BWF World Tour Title
results.description: In a remarkable achievement, 17-year-old Tanvi Sharma has won her first BWF World Tour title at the Taipei Open, defeating Vietnam's Thuy Linh Nguyen in straight games. This victory not only marks a significant milestone in her career but also makes her the youngest champion in the tournament's history. Coached by PV Sindhu's former mentor, Tanvi's journey to the title was filled with determination and skill, showcasing her potential as a rising star in badminton. Her mother, a former national volleyball player, has played a crucial role in her training, emphasizing the hard work and dedication that led to this historic win. Read on to discover more about Tanvi's inspiring journey and her future aspirations in the sport.
